review_findings.issue: GUC set on a single pool connection via client.query('SET ...') then released; subsequent pool.query() calls can dispatch to a different connection without the GUC set. Reliable in CI (pool-of-1) but fragile if pool size increases.
review_findings.suggestion: Use pool.on('connect', ...) pattern (as in bridge-smoke-runner.ts) so GUC is set on every new connection.

review_findings.issue: `const pool = jobStore['pool'] as pg.Pool` — private field access via string index; rename of private field breaks silently at runtime.
review_findings.suggestion: Accept pool explicitly in makeExternalTaskDeliver(flowableClient, pool, onDispatched?) per ADR §4.3 injected-pool pattern.

review_findings.issue: `void workerId;` is redundant noise — workerId is used directly on lines 150-155.

promote_guide_GT3.what_is_new: External Task ↔ JobStore bridge (E6.2): poll-loop (startBridgePollLoop) fetches Flowable external tasks per topic, enqueues them in pgJobStore with idempotency_key=externalTask.id, and delivers outbox completions back to Flowable via completeTask/failTask. Pull model is fully closed: Flowable → JobStore → worker HTTP API → Flowable.
